headline: Iran War Odds Through 2026
status: Saudi-led jets hit Houthi oil sites in Yemen and the Houthis fired missiles at Dhahran and Riyadh, while UKMTO reported a tanker and a container ship hit by unidentified projectiles in Hormuz. No one has claimed those hits and none involves a Saudi relay ship, and the IRGC's threat to sink US warships is rhetoric with no attack behind it, so no tripwire fired and the odds hold.

bets.cond: Iran accepts US sequencing, or round two is set with text
Iran ends strait tolls and permits, or declares Hormuz open to all shipping
Iran offers a concrete cut in enrichment capacity, in text or on the record
